Theatre Project draws on transcripts of interviews with real people connected to this album to create a well-performed, engaging documentary drama that gradually uncovers the names of those in the pictures and the horrific roles they played in the death camps.
It is nonetheless a thoughtful and fascinating piece of theatre.

cn.t: This forensic docudrama about Nazi photos from Auschwitz divides critics. Most praise its powerful, compelling examination of complicity and the banality of evil, though some question whether the story justifies itself ethically.
